name: common-mod
description: Claude Code mods (function hooks that draw inside the CLI and the desktop Code tab): recall — type @@ to pull a past Claude Code, desktop or Cowork conversation into the prompt, /recall for a per-project activity strata; side — /side opens a throwaway side chat beside the transcript, answered from the main conversation without touching it, with 看不懂 (re-explain a reply) and 畫給我看 (a plain-text diagram of a reply) on hover.

recallExtraRoots.title: recall：其他對話紀錄資料夾
recallExtraRoots.description: 除了 ~/.claude/projects 之外要一起搜尋的資料夾，用分號分隔，例如 WSL 的 \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\<you>\.claude\projects
